steps.title: Use images from AEM Assets
items: 1 · Content view: drag an asset from the AEM Assets panel
2 · Layout view: Replace image › AEM Assets

steps.caption: Create a page: **New** › Page, name it, **Create**

steps.name: AEM Assets
steps.caption: Open **Panels** › **AEM Assets**: approved assets from AEM as a Cloud Service

steps.name: image8.jpg
steps.caption: Drag an asset into the document
The asset is on the page: no download, no re-upload
Switch to **Layout** view to see the page as visitors will

steps.name: image5.jpg
steps.caption: Click the image › **Replace image** › **AEM Assets**, pick one, **Select**
The new asset replaces the old one in place
The previewed page shows the AEM asset

steps.title: Approved assets, right in the editor
items: Content view: drag from Panels › AEM Assets
Layout view: Replace image › AEM Assets
Assets must be approved and published in AEM
